At this source the scene-authored postcard point [1.41, -1.41] lies in an open slip of the rebuilt shore: the walk surface there is 0.92 m, at the water, below the 3.4 m deck. The camera stands on the deck 5 m away with the authored bearing. The authored point itself needs a source fix.

Headless Chromium (Playwright), ANGLE Direct3D 11 on an NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5070 (hardware GL, audio muted). Earlier collections in this record were rendered with SwiftShader, so small shading and anti-aliasing differences are not scene changes.
